title.value: In Search of Robust Measures of Generalization
title.justification: The title is prominently displayed on the top of the paper.
title.quote: In Search of Robust Measures of Generalization

analysis.description: The paper addresses the challenge of generalization in deep learning by proposing an empirical methodology for evaluating generalization bounds through large-scale studies. It critiques existing methods and suggests the use of distributional robustness as a framework for evaluation.

type.justification: The paper focuses on empirical evaluations of generalization bounds using large-scale studies and experiments.
type.quote: We propose that the framework of distributional robustness is more appropriate, and suggest how to use it to evaluate generalization measures.

name.justification: The paper primarily discusses the evaluation and improvement of generalization measures in deep learning models.
name.quote: One of the principal scientific challenges in deep learning is explaining generalization.

name.justification: The paper involves theoretical discussions on generalization measures and distributional robustness.
name.quote: This work addresses the question of how to evaluate such bounds empirically.

name.justification: The empirical studies focus on supervised classification settings.
name.quote: We focus our attention on the simplest setting within supervised classification.

name.justification: CIFAR-10 is explicitly mentioned as one of the datasets used for empirical evaluations.
name.quote: We collect data from thousands of experiments on CIFAR-10 and SVHN.
